text.tspan: Mortality and Emigration can’t remove more animals than the population has. Lower D and/or E.
Change the numbers and repeat, for as many years as
you like — watch the graph to see whether the
population is growing, shrinking, or staying stable.
is the size of a population — the number of individuals of a species
living in a given area at a given time.
is the number of births added to the population during a given period.
is the number of individuals of the same species that enter the habitat from
is the number of deaths in the population during that period.
is the number of individuals that leave the habitat for elsewhere during that
: if (B + I) is greater than (D + E), the population grows.
